descriptionChirho: A proper noun denoting the town of Eshtaol, a settlement in the tribal allotment of Dan near Zorah, associated with Samson's early life and the Danite migration. All occurrences — bare, with conjunctions (and-Eshtaol), or with prepositions (from-Eshtaol) — refer to the same geographic location. Multilingual evidence confirms a single referent: eng 'Eshtaol', spa 'Estaol', hin 'एश्ताओल', arb 'أَشْتَاؤُلَ', kor '에스다올', swa 'Eshtaoli'.
